'''Talismans of ensnarement''' were [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magical]] [[Sith talisman/Legends|devices]] that were nearly identical to [[Talisman of concentration|concentration talismans]] in function, except that they also had the ability to instantly transform a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] into a proponent of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Because [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-siders]] figured out ways to use Sith amulets for benevolent purposes, [[Sith sorcerer]]s created ensnarement talismans with enough of the dark side's corrosive power to bring unsuspecting [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] under its influence. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] outlawed use of Sith amulets for any means as a result, to prevent anyone from falling into darkness.
